disposition.reason: An appeal of the Georgia Planning Commission's preliminary plat for a 5-lot subdivision. The documents never say the lots are for housing, so it is not new housing.

evidence.quote: Perras & Sons Inc. 5-Lot Subdiv. Prelim. Plat     Docket No. 243-11-07 Vtec
the Court placed the pending preliminary plat appeal on inactive status, pending the outcome of an application for final plat approval.

judgments.note: Person ruling: a subdivision whose lots aren't stated to be for housing is not new housing.
